content.title: Zelensky Proposes Ukraine Withdrawal from Donbas for Nato Membership
content.caption: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has proposed Ukraine's withdrawal from the eastern Donbas region in exchange for Nato membership. The proposal follows recent meetings between US envoys and Ukrainian President Zelensky and Russian President Putin.
